name: cogestione-vian
description: Piattaforma della Cogestione del Liceo Scientifico Statale Ignazio Vian - Bracciano

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
